/* include/coap3/coap_option.h, lines 144-158 */
/**
 * Use byte-oriented access methods here because sliding a complex struct
 * coap_opt_t over the data buffer may cause bus error on certain platforms.
 */
typedef uint8_t coap_opt_t;
#define PCHAR(p) ((coap_opt_t *)(p))

/**
 * Representation of CoAP options.
 */
typedef struct {
  uint16_t delta;
  size_t length;
  const uint8_t *value;
} coap_option_t;

/* include/coap3/coap_pdu_internal.h, line 96 */
#define COAP_PAYLOAD_START 0xFF /* payload marker */

/* Stand-in, not from libcoap: the debug log messages of coap_opt_parse do nothing. */
#define coap_log_debug(...) do { } while (0)

/* Not from libcoap: the buffer that the harness passes when the given length is 6 or more.
 * The longest option header is 5 bytes and the longest value 65804 bytes. */
static unsigned char case_buffer[65809];
input_domain: the first five bytes of the option buffer (the header byte, then up to two extra delta bytes and two extra length bytes) with every value, and a buffer length from 0 to 65809 (the longest header of 5 bytes plus the longest value of 65804 bytes); bytes of the buffer after the fifth are zero and are not read by the function
limitations: coap_opt_parse with ADVANCE_OPT and ADVANCE_OPT_CHECK; the callers (option iterators, PDU parsing) are not examined; the type definitions, COAP_PAYLOAD_START and a buffer are not extracted by the gate but copied or written into the prelude from include/coap3/coap_option.h and include/coap3/coap_pdu_internal.h at the same revision; coap_log_debug is a macro that does nothing, so the log messages are not examined; the function does not read option value bytes, so the value bytes are not modelled; the contents of the result structure are checked only when the function returns a size other than 0; the check that nothing else is written looks at four guard bytes on each side of the result structure and does not look at its padding
